cards.prompt: Open this laptop the way a technician would, and make it **safe to work on**.

actions.nudge: All four screws have to come out first.

cards.explanation: Screws, then the panel, then **unplug the battery** before touching any other part.
RAM is the long stick covered in small chips. The square chip is the CPU, and the smaller card is storage.

cards.prompt: Match each part to what it does.
cards.explanation: The **CPU** does the work, **RAM** is the workspace, **storage** keeps things for later, and the **fan** keeps the CPU cool.

items.label: The video you're watching right now
A game you installed last month

cards.explanation: Things in use right now are in **RAM**. Saved and installed things stay in **storage**, even when the device is off.

cards.prompt: A phone has **64 GB** of free storage. Each video you film takes up **4 GB**. How many videos fit?
Which job gets **faster** with more CPU cores?

options.text: Solving a puzzle where every step needs the one before

cards.explanation: Separate photos can be shared between cores. A chain of steps has to go in order, and cores don't change how much storage you have.

cards.prompt: A laptop gets very hot while gaming and suddenly runs slower. What's happening?

options.text: The CPU is slowing itself down to stay safe

cards.explanation: Too much heat makes the CPU **throttle**: it lowers its clock speed to protect itself. Clear vents and a working fan help it stay at full speed.
